questions.question: A web app automatically adds instances when traffic increases and removes them when traffic decreases. Which cloud benefit is this?

options.why: Predictability concerns consistent performance and cost.
Manageability concerns how you manage resources.
Governance is about rules and compliance.

questions.question: What best describes the difference between scalability and elasticity?

options.text: Elasticity is the automatic adjustment of resources based on demand; scalability is the ability to adjust resources
Scalability only works on-premises; elasticity only works in the cloud
options.why: Both concepts apply to cloud systems.

options.text: They mean exactly the same thing
options.why: Elasticity specifically implies automatic, real-time scaling.

options.text: Elasticity only scales up; scalability only scales down

questions.explanation: All elastic systems are scalable, but elasticity adds automatic, rapid response to demand.

questions.question: Which Azure feature lets a group of identical VMs automatically increase or decrease in number based on demand?

options.why: Availability sets spread VMs across fault domains; they do not autoscale.

questions.explanation: VM Scale Sets support autoscale to add or remove identical VM instances.

questions.question: Which TWO are benefits of elasticity?

options.text: Reduced cost by removing unused resources automatically
Capacity that keeps up with sudden spikes without manual action

questions.explanation: Elasticity matches capacity to demand automatically, reducing waste and handling spikes.
